headline: Ye’s Yeezy Season 01 runway show brings out Kid Cudi, Big Sean, Nettspend, 2 Chainz and mo
body: Ye’s Yeezy Season 01 runway show brings out Kid Cudi, Big Sean, Nettspend, 2 Chainz and more. On Wednesday night (Nov. 4), the artist formerly known as Kanye West put on his first Yeezy fashion show in over four years in Los Angeles. Taking place at Droam 1, Yeezy’s new flagship located on Beverly Boulevard, several hip-hop artists were in attendance, including Kid Cudi, Big Sean, 2 Chainz, Rich The Kid and King Combs. Nettspend walked the runway at the show.
